training_selection: all ten predeclared training splits pooled; no holdout rows

task.population: Grade12 educational prototype; transfer validity unknown
task.target: current-profile score on 0–100 scale; not a validated forecast
task.sleep: union asleep hours yesterday local noon to min(refresh,today noon)
task.steps: previous completed local calendar day sum
task.exercise_minutes: previous completed local calendar day sum
task.resting_heart_rate: latest valid positive finite sample startDate in inclusive last72 elapsed hours; timestamp retained
task.study_minutes: latest saved user-entered minutes; reporting period/date unknown
task.screen_time_minutes: latest saved user-entered minutes; reporting period/date/content unknown
task.previous_score: latest saved 0–100 user score; date/subject/comparability unknown

missing_policy: abstain on missing required input; never substitute zero
metadata_gate: existing health-window freshness and RHR timestamp checks; no invented 28-day coverage or manual-entry date
input_transforms: none except StandardScaler; nonlinear functions belong only to synthetic target generation
what_if_time_constraint: Different source periods; do not sum all inputs into one fictitious 24-hour day
